messages:
Alex: Heads-up — prod-gpu-pool-7 showing a ~65% throughput drop starting ~12:21 UTC, many worker restarts. Seeing OOMs and high alloc-fail counters. Investigating now.
infra-bot: alert: high-restart-rate on prod-gpu-pool-7 (node-set-3). Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/prod/gpu-pool-7/dashboard 
Sam: grabbing pprof and runtime logs from the most recent crashed worker, uploading bundle to /tmp/pprof-bundle-1765432100.tgz 
Sam: pprof top (summary):
```
pprof top
1  43.2%  cudaAlloc
2  22.7%  kv_cache::evict_scan
3  10.1%  kernel_selector::choose_path
4   8.4%  batcher::coalesce_prefix
5   6.7%  allocator::sweep_jitter
```
Note: cudaAlloc spikes just before restart, evict_scan is unusually high on affected nodes.
Maria: pulled dmesg from node-7-12, seeing repeated OOM kills and slab warnings: 
```
[Wed Mar 18 12:20:58] Out of memory: Kill process 4221 (worker) score 977 or sacrifice child
[Wed Mar 18 12:21:01] slab: failed to allocate 4096 bytes, order 0
[Wed Mar 18 12:21:02] kernel-switch: selector switched kernel fastpath -> safe_path (reason: kv-hotset-frag)
```
Devon: quick context — we rolled kernel-picker v3 to 30% yesterday (opt/kernel-heuristic-v3, commit abc1234) which changes preferring safe_path when kv-compaction lag > 40s. That safe_path uses larger temp allocations for coalescing.
Jia: I think the kv compactor deferred-window bump from yesterday (PR #4210) increased compaction latency under noisy-hotset growth. Hotset expanded -> evict_scan frequency + coalescer contention -> fragmentation.
Sam: repro on canary: small-batch bursts -> coalescer triggers safe_path, kernel chooser thrashes between fast/safe -> allocator sweep jitter -> cudaAlloc spikes -> OOM. Repro steps in gist: https://gist.redwood/repro-1765432100
Alex: @Devon can you pause the rollout and rollback picker v3 on pool-7 canaries? We need to get stable ASAP.
Devon: rolling back kernel-picker v3 on pool-7 canary nodes now (run: /ops/rollout rollback opt/kernel-heuristic-v3 --pool prod-gpu-pool-7 --percent 30 -> 0). Patching 8 nodes.
infra-bot: rollout/rollback started by Devon at 12:29 UTC.
infra-bot: rollback complete on 8 canary nodes at 12:34 UTC.
Alex: preliminary numbers — throughput on rolled back nodes recovering to ~90% of baseline. Still a handful of restarts on older workers.
Maria: collected heap profiles + pmap dumps from affected processes, uploaded to s3://redwood-internal/incidents/1765432100/ for postmortem.
Jia: temp mitigation: PR #4321 opened to add a soft guard to batching heuristic that caps coalescer buffer growth under high-evict_scan rates. Will land as a feature-flagged change.
Sam: next steps: run targeted synthetic workload (small streaming batches) against a canary cluster with kernel-picker v3 disabled + compactor params reverted to validate.
Ops-Bot: scheduled canary test: synthetic-small-burst x1000 at 13:15 UTC, target pool prod-gpu-pool-7-canary.
Devon: logging owners: Sam (profiling & repro), Maria (system logs & heap dumps), Jia (kv compaction & batching guard), Devon (rollouts). Alex will draft incident report.
Alex: Good work — treat as P2 perf incident. We’ll write a short postmortem after we validate the guard and run the canary tests. :thumbsup:
